# The Fairy type (optional)

Rowan's first question at the start of the game turns the Fairy type on or off. With it on, the game uses the Gen 6 type chart and these changes. With it off, everything is as in Black 2.

## Pokémon that gain the Fairy type

| Clefable | Fairy |
| Jigglypuff | Normal / Fairy |
| Wigglytuff | Normal / Fairy |
| Mr. Mime | Psychic / Fairy |

## Moves that become Fairy-type

- Sweet Kiss
- Charm
- Moonlight
